test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ___________ was awarded the title of Hanjaba by the Maharaja of Manipur and the Sangit Natak Akademi Award in 1966.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Guru Bipin Singh__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The name** Guru Bipin Singh** is synonymous with Manipuri dance.
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a director, choreographer, and teacher of Manipuri dance.
